section.title: Purpose
section.p: The examples provided with the projects are used in four different situations.

ul.li: The developers use the applications to debug and test their frameworks. The example must be integrated in the development environemnt and support fast develop, compile, debug cycles.
Sanity checks and nightly build checks use the applications to test the latest release. The nightly checks should be run unattended.
The integration team use the applications to test the release package before publishing it.

The users use the applications to verify the downloaded package and to see how features of the framework can be integrated in their projects. The example must be simple to install and run without additional configuration steps.

section.p: A major goal of the design is that all usage modes use the same source code, build and run scripts. Exactly one source code tree is managed by the development team.

section.title: Rules
section.p: The following rules simplify the creation and deployment of complete examples.

ul.li: The source code of the example is defined as source directories in the eclipse environment. The example is compiled with the environment builder and debugged with the integrated debugger.

The sanity checks compile the same source files as in the ones used in eclipse. The example is build and run using Ant. The compilation results are stored in a seperate directory. All needed libraries are stored in a seperate directory to minimize dependencies to other projects in the eclipse workspace.
